title: fun to try but not the best quality tea
text: i got the first box for a discount and was glad i got to try it...the variety pack came with a green, an herbal mix, an oolong, and a black tea. the herbal tea was the best of the bunch - but also had the fewest amount of tea leaves in it. the oolong was pretty awful...maybe okay if you've never had oolong but it was bland and mediocre. i honestly can't even remember the green tea (a hojicha or genmaicha? you can get much better at the japanese grocery store)...the black was a lavender earl grey, smelled lovely and tasted okay. i think this is a fun little treat if you like variety/are not too picky about your tea quality, but a little overpriced for nothing out of the ordinary.
label: neutral
